verdict: H420 holds: the phenomenon is prior art, so this programme must not present it as a new mechanism or method

but: a pre-registered measurement of the SHAPE of the effect: a step function in identity availability rather than a gradient, with the fully-informed gain at exactly zero
a matched-pair battery: same-dimensional random blocks, permuted drug-to-pathway maps, dead blocks, drug marginals, target annotation
a model-family separation: magnitude depends on the family, the ordering does not
an explicit capability boundary: the model ranks combinations, not cells
a cost estimate for prospective verification: about 1,600 keys, allocation-insensitive

the_one_sentence_positioning: this is not a new mechanism but a quantified, pre-registered account of when a known effect holds, what it does not do, and what it would cost to verify
limits: Title and abstract level only, because full-text fetch is refused on this machine.
Three query groups, not a systematic review.
